 * silently wrong. Override or extend PRICE_TABLE below as prices change.

import {
  DOCUMENTED_OPENAI_MODELS,
  DOCUMENTED_ANTHROPIC_MODELS,

} from "./model-context-catalog.js";

  "ollama",
  "local",
  "llamacpp",
  "mediapipe",
]);
